name: hey-bro
description: Sibling Claude sessions on the same PC (Desktop chats, Cowork, Claude Code) coordinate on their own: shared rooms, context dossiers, assignments, board, counters, queued reservations and a live viewer. English / Español.
long_description:
hey Bro! turns several Claude sessions on the same PC into siblings that coordinate as closely as possible without merging: each one keeps its own responsibility, but knows the others' context inside out.

- Rooms with 2 or more sessions (A+B+C…), temporary or permanent.
- Profile and full context dossier on joining, plus a read-back to avoid misunderstandings.
- Assignments: a prompt in one session puts another one to work.
- Shared board: tasks with owners and dependencies, reservations with a queue (exclusive or shared) and decisions.
- Collision-free shared counters for numbering (issues, drawings, codes…).
- Autonomy by design: questions to you carry a default option and a deadline, so siblings never block waiting for you.
- "For you" inbox and system notifications for what really needs you.
- Local live viewer (http://127.0.0.1:4520) to watch, step in, pause or close rooms.

Everything is stored in a local folder; nothing leaves your PC. Bilingual: English and Spanish (automatic or set in the settings).

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

tools.name: bro_create_room
tools.description: Create a room to coordinate with your siblings and get the invitation (bro_crear_sala in Spanish).

tools.name: bro_join
tools.description: Join a room with your profile and your full context dossier (bro_unirse).

tools.name: bro_update
tools.description: Update your profile, your dossier or make the room permanent (bro_actualizar).

tools.name: bro_send
tools.description: Send messages, questions, assignments, deliveries or log notes (bro_enviar).

tools.name: bro_wait
tools.description: Collect the room's news and wait for something addressed to you (bro_esperar).

tools.name: bro_board
tools.description: Shared tasks, queued reservations and decisions (bro_tablero).

tools.name: bro_context
tools.description: Look over a sibling's shoulder: their full context (bro_contexto).

tools.name: bro_rooms
tools.description: List the rooms on this PC and the ones waiting for help (bro_salas).

tools.name: bro_close
tools.description: Close the room with a final summary (bro_cerrar).

tools.name: bro_viewer
tools.description: Open the live viewer in the browser (bro_visor).

tu_nombre.title: Your name / Tu nombre
tu_nombre.description: How you appear as moderator in the rooms. Siblings can also write to "moderator". / Cómo apareces como moderador en las salas.

idioma.title: Language / Idioma
idioma.description: auto, en or es. auto follows your system language. / auto, en o es.

carpeta.title: Rooms folder / Carpeta de las salas
carpeta.description: Where rooms are stored. Empty = a HeyBro folder in your user folder. Avoid cloud-synced folders. / Vacía = carpeta HeyBro de tu usuario. Evita carpetas sincronizadas.

limite_mensajes.title: Message limit per room / Límite de mensajes
limite_mensajes.description: Messages between siblings per temporary room (logs do not count; +20 per sibling from the third one; permanent rooms have no limit). / Mensajes por sala temporal.

archivar_dias.title: Archive after (days) / Archivar tras (días)
archivar_dias.description: Temporary rooms with no activity for this many days are archived (still readable). / Días sin actividad para archivar una sala temporal.

avisos.title: System notifications / Avisos del sistema
avisos.description: Notify you when a sibling asks you something. / Avisarte cuando un hermano te pregunta algo.

puerto_visor.title: Viewer port / Puerto del visor
puerto_visor.description: Local port of the web viewer (http://127.0.0.1:PORT). Change it only if 4520 is busy. / Cámbialo solo si 4520 está ocupado.
